annotations.title: Self-employment tax and quarterly estimated tax planner

description: Estimate self-employment tax, the safe-harbor amount of estimated tax, and what is left to pay at each remaining 2026 or 2027 due date. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

amtJoint.description: Additional Medicare Tax threshold, married filing jointly (US dollars). Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 250000 USD from IRS Questions and answers for the Additional Medicare Tax, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when filing is mfj; ignored otherwise.

amtRate.description: Additional Medicare Tax rate. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 0.9% from IRS Questions and answers for the Additional Medicare Tax, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

amtSep.description: Additional Medicare Tax threshold, married filing separately (US dollars). Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 125000 USD from IRS Questions and answers for the Additional Medicare Tax, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when filing is mfs; ignored otherwise.

amtSingle.description: Additional Medicare Tax threshold, single or head of household (US dollars). Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 200000 USD from IRS Questions and answers for the Additional Medicare Tax, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when filing is single; ignored otherwise.

base2026.description: 2026 Social Security wage base (US dollars). Maximum combined wages and self-employment earnings subject to the 12.4% Social Security part. Official reference value 184500 USD from SSA 2027 COLA fact sheet (2026 column), effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when year is 2026; ignored otherwise.

base2027.description: 2027 Social Security wage base (US dollars). Maximum combined wages and self-employment earnings subject to the 12.4% Social Security part. Official reference value 192300 USD from SSA 2027 COLA fact sheet, effective 2027-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when year is 2027; ignored otherwise.

currentPct.description: Current-year safe harbor percentage. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 90% from IRS Form 1040-ES (2026), effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

deductions.description: Deductions after AGI (your figure) (US dollars). Your standard or itemized deduction plus any QBI or other below-the-line deductions. The example is illustrative, not an official amount. Used only when incomeMethod is rate; ignored otherwise.

effRate.description: Effective federal income tax rate (your figure). Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Your expected income tax divided by taxable income, for example from last year’s return. The example is illustrative. Used only when incomeMethod is rate; ignored otherwise.

filing.description: Filing status (for the Additional Medicare Tax threshold). Pick the option that matches your situation for the tax year. Options: single = Single, head of household or qualifying surviving spouse; mfj = Married filing jointly; mfs = Married filing separately.

incomeMethod.description: How to estimate federal income tax. Pick the option that matches your situation for the tax year. Options: rate = Effective income tax rate on estimated taxable income; entered = Enter the income tax amount.

incomeTax.description: Estimated federal income tax after credits (your figure) (US dollars). From a tax-software projection or your preparer. Used only when incomeMethod is entered; ignored otherwise.

medRate.description: Medicare part of SE tax. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Applied to all net earnings from self-employment. Official reference value 2.9% from IRS Self-employment tax (Social Security and Medicare taxes), effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

medWages.description: W-2 Medicare wages this year (US dollars). Form W-2 box 5 from any job, projected for the year. Used only for the Additional Medicare Tax threshold.

netProfit.description: Net profit from self-employment for the year (US dollars). Schedule C line 31 (or Schedule F / partnership SE earnings) projected for the whole year. Use a loss as 0.

next.description: Next unpaid installment. Pick the option that matches your situation for the tax year. Options: 1 = Q1 (April); 2 = Q2 (June); 3 = Q3 (September); 4 = Q4 (January of the next year).

otherIncome.description: Other income in AGI, including W-2 wages (US dollars). Wages, interest and other income for the same return. Leave out the self-employment profit entered above. Used only when incomeMethod is rate; ignored otherwise.

paid.description: Estimated tax payments already made for this year (US dollars). Total of this year’s 1040-ES payments already sent, including an overpayment applied from last year.

prior100.description: Prior-year safe harbor percentage. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 100% from IRS Form 1040-ES (2026), effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when safeHarbor is p100; ignored otherwise.

prior110.description: Prior-year safe harbor percentage, higher AGI. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 110% from IRS Form 1040-ES (2026), effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when safeHarbor is p110; ignored otherwise.

priorTax.description: Total tax on the prior-year return (US dollars). Total tax line of last year’s Form 1040. Used only when safeHarbor is p100 or p110; ignored otherwise.

safeHarbor.description: Prior-year safe harbor. Pick the option that matches your situation for the tax year. Options: p100 = 100% of prior-year tax (prior-year AGI $150,000 or less; $75,000 if married filing separately); p110 = 110% of prior-year tax (prior-year AGI over $150,000; over $75,000 if married filing separately); none = No 12-month prior-year return: use 90% of this year’s tax only.

seFactor.description: Share of net profit subject to SE tax. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Net earnings from self-employment are 92.35% of net profit. Official reference value 92.35% from IRS Form 1040-ES (2026), effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

ssRate.description: Social Security part of SE tax. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Applied up to the wage base after W-2 wages. Official reference value 12.4% from IRS Self-employment tax (Social Security and Medicare taxes), effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

ssWages.description: W-2 wages subject to Social Security this year (US dollars). Form W-2 box 3 plus box 7 from any job, projected for the year. These use up the Social Security wage base first.

withholding.description: Federal income tax withheld for the year (US dollars). Projected withholding from W-2 jobs or other income for the whole year.

year.description: Tax year being planned. Pick the option that matches your situation for the tax year. Options: 2026 = 2026 (Q4 payment due Jan 15, 2027); 2027 = 2027.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.
